scans.sanitized_input: Bijli bill update: Priye grahak aapka bijli bill update nahi hua hai. Aaj raat 9:30 baje electricity supply disconnect h...
scans.verdict: High-Confidence Fraudulent Message (Electricity Extortion Scam)

detected_signals.name: Unsolicited Embedded Links
detected_signals.detail: Contains suspicious web links (1 found). Legitimate institutions rarely send unshortened direct update links via SMS.

detected_signals.name: Personal Contact Solicitation
detected_signals.detail: Routes recipient to call personal mobile numbers (9876543210) instead of verified enterprise toll-free helplines.

detected_signals.name: Psychological Pressure: Urgency / Threat (Hindi/Hinglish)
detected_signals.detail: Leverages emotional trigger 'aaj raat' to prompt immediate uncritical reaction.

detected_signals.name: Brand Spoofing: Utility / DISCOM Impersonation
detected_signals.detail: Impersonates trusted institution or public authority: 'ELECTRICITY OFFICER'.

recommendations: DO NOT click any link in this message or dial the included phone number.
DO NOT share OTPs, PINs, or install apps (especially APKs, AnyDesk, or TeamViewer).
Forward this message to 1909 (Telecom DND Fraud Reporting) or report via the Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu) portal.
If you already shared financial information, call the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930 immediately.

detected_signals.detail: Imposes artificial '12 hours' deadline to provoke impulsive clicking

detected_signals.name: Government/Postal Spoofing
detected_signals.detail: Impersonates India Post (Department of Posts)

detected_signals.name: Suspicious TLD (.vip)

detected_signals.detail: Extracts small 're-delivery fee' of Rs 25 to capture credit/debit card details

scans.verdict: Electricity Bill Disconnection Extortion Fraud (Hindi/Hinglish)

detected_signals.name: Utility Supply Threat
detected_signals.detail: Threatens power cutoff at '9:30 baje' to cause panic

detected_signals.name: Unauthorized Phone Contact
detected_signals.detail: Routes victims to a scammer's personal mobile number instead of DISCOM call center

detected_signals.name: Remote Access Trojan Vector
detected_signals.detail: Known to request installation of AnyDesk/TeamViewer/RustDesk under the guise of an APK

recommendations: Electricity distribution boards (DISCOMs) never send personal mobile numbers for bill payments.
Never install any APK or screen-sharing application (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) instructed over a phone call.
Verify your bill status directly on your official state electricity board portal or authorized app.
